drafted.title: Vite Resolves a Workspace Alias as Source Code Instead of the Published Package Entry
drafted.description: Vite imports the wrong workspace file when an alias points at source instead of the package entry point.
drafted.angle: Open with the import that resolves to an unexpected workspace path. Explain Vite's alias precedence, how `resolve.alias`, package exports, and source shortcuts interact, and why development can appear correct while production bundles differ. Show how to point imports at the public entry surface and avoid leaking internal source paths into consumers.
